stem.en: The graph shows the position-time lines of two joggers, P and Q. They start from the same point at the same time. Which statement is correct?

text.en: P and Q move at the same velocity, because both lines start at the origin.

feedback.en: Starting together does not make the velocities equal. Compare how steep the lines are.

text.en: Q is faster, because its line stays lower.

feedback.en: A lower line means Q is less far from the start at each instant. It covers less in the same time.

text.en: P is faster, because its line is steeper.

feedback.en: Right. In the same time, P's position changes more, so its slope, and its velocity, is larger.

explanation.en: The slope of a position-time graph gives the velocity. P's line is steeper (3 m/s) than Q's (1.2 m/s), so P is faster.

hints.en: Which line rises more in the same time?
